chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 346 - Han Li's Brush with a Core Formation Enemy
chapter_meta_description: Han Li barely escapes a giant mantis attack and realizes the trap was set by a former Core Formation cultivator. Now he must kill the body-snatcher before the enemy recovers his strength.
og_title: Chapter 346: Shock and Suspicion - Han Li's Near-Fatal Ambush
og_description: The trap was deeper than he thought. Han Li faces the horrifying truth that his enemy may have once been a Core Formation cultivator—and must act before it's too late.
twitter_title: Han Li vs a Core Formation Ghost!
twitter_description: After barely surviving a mantis attack, Han Li realizes his enemy is a fallen Core Formation cultivator. Time to finish the fight.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade offensive artifact infused with dense killing energy; once activated, it releases a devastating strike against the target.
A yellow paper talisman painted with silver symbols that completely immobilizes a target's body and spirit, leaving them conscious but helpless.
The third major cultivation realm; cultivators at this stage form an internal golden core, vastly extending their lifespan and granting far greater power than Foundation Establishment.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why couldn’t Han Li just kill Qu Hun immediately after returning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the enemy still had hidden cards—he had a way to move despite the Spirit-Fixing Talismans and even blocked Han Li’s attack with a green light from his mouth, proving he wasn’t as defenseless as he appeared.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Han Li guess the man was a Core Formation cultivator?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He deduced it from the giant mantis’s impossible strength—a beast that could handle three or four late-Foundation Establishment cultivators could not have been tamed by a Foundation Establishment master. Combined with the man’s deep knowledge of demonic invasion secrets, only a Core Formation origin made sense.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happens to a cultivator after possession?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Their previous cultivation is lost; they must rebuild from scratch, but they retain their memories, techniques, and soul-level comprehension, allowing them to re-cultivate without bottlenecks—assuming they survive the vulnerable period.
